question_text:
HOTSPOT
-

You are developing an app that will use the Azure AI Vision API to analyze an image.

You need configure the request that will be used by the app to identify whether an image is clipart or a line drawing.

How should you complete the request? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
discussion:
POST, imagetype
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/computervision/analyze-image/analyze-image?view=rest-computervision-v3.2&tabs=HTTP

Post
imageType

POST is CORRECT because the Azure AI Vision API requires a POST request to analyze an image. The POST method is used to submit data to be processed to a specified resource, which in this case is the Vision API endpoint. This allows the API to perform the image analysis and return the results.

imageType is CORRECT because this value is used in the Azure AI Vision API to identify whether an image is clipart or a line drawing. The imageType visual feature provides information about the type of image being analyzed, including whether it is clipart, a line drawing, or a regular photograph.

POST + imageType, for me and ChatGPT too
